name: @secscan/redteam-runner
description: Live engagement runner for the secscan red-team: authorize -> plan -> recon -> exploit -> report, with streaming event logs.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-dir.mjs src/ui/public dist/ui/public && node scripts/copy-dir.mjs assets dist/assets && node scripts/dist-hash.mjs write . && node scripts/stamp-deps.mjs
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/stamp-deps.mjs && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
